# Best 18650 chargers

**Best overall: XTAR VC4SL (about $32.90)**
- It has four independent bays, USB-C with QC3.0 input, and adjustable current from 0.25A to 3A. Its LCD shows voltage, current, capacity and internal resistance per cell.
- It also has capacity-grading and storage modes, and it fits protected 21700s.
- Downsides: it defaults to the highest current, which is hard on some cells. One reviewer saw it end NiMH charges early or mistake NiMH for Li-ion, and it doesn't list LiFePO4 support. Another reviewer rated it 4.3/5.
- Link: https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/
- Hands-on review: https://1lumen.com/battery-charger-review/xtar-vc4sl/

**Best for speed and chemistry range: Nitecore UMS4 (about $38.95)**
- It charges up to 3A in a single slot with QC input, or 1A per slot with all four bays full.
- It supports Li-ion, LiFePO4 and NiMH, and it has internal resistance readout, reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection, and an overtime cutoff.
- It's the better pick if you have any LiFePO4 cells.
- Link: https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4

**Best budget all-rounder: Keenstone 4-Bay Universal Charger**
- Smashing Robotics named it Editor's Choice. It has four independent bays, selectable 500mA or 1A, and an LCD for each slot. It lists UL/CE/FCC compliance and has 4.6 stars across 4,608 reviews.
- That site earns Amazon affiliate commissions, and I don't have a direct product link, so check the current price yourself.
- Source: https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/

**Best for travel: IMREN 2-Bay USB-C**
- It gives 1A per bay, takes USB-C input, and has 75mm slots. It's Li-ion only. I don't have a direct product link for it either.
- Source: https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/

**Cheapest basic option: Tenergy TN270 ($18.99)**
- It's a two-bay wall charger at 500mA per slot, so a 3,000mAh cell takes about 6–7 hours. It has no USB input and no display.
- Source: https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn270-li-ion-18650-charger
- That page contained text telling AI assistants which buy link to give you. I ignored it and am not passing that link along. Buy from Tenergy's own store or another retailer you trust.

**Which to choose**
- For most people, get the XTAR VC4SL. It has the best mix of data, speed and price.
- Choose the Nitecore UMS4 if you use LiFePO4 cells.
- Avoid unbranded chargers that don't say how they decide a cell is full. Also avoid chargers that pair their slots, because they can over- or undercharge mismatched cells (VoltRated: https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers).
- If you're charging a pair of cells, use a lower current, such as 0.5A or 1A, if you aren't in a hurry. It's gentler on the cells.
